title: Read the whole repository and its CI from Project Intent

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-420#browse-the-project-at-a-revision

**Checked revision:** 7624ed6e709c076a025fc126297749a0eb91e69b (branch claude/read-the-whole-repository-and-its-ci-from-projec). Scratch detached worktree installed with `npm ci` on Node 24.21.0, removed afterwards.

**Promise:** With no story selected, Project Intent reads a selected file's source at the shown revision through the dashboard's local project read (`intent=project-file`), and opening a recorded Purpose case reads that source once. Story: .planning/seeds/SEED-420-unified-intent-review.md#browse-the-project-at-a-revision ("Keep navigation pinned to the displayed revision… selected source use that revision"). Plan: .planning/slice-plans/841-browse-the-project-at-a-revision/PLAN.md.

**Fault:** dashboard/src/useIntentFileRead.ts:55 `const readFile = wholeProject ? reads.readProjectFile : reads.readFile;` → `const readFile = reads.readFile;` (project-scope source back through the upstream reader). Fixtures and assertions unchanged. The per-pin cache fault was not run: the maintained spec never reselects a file.

**Maintained check:** e2e/intent/intent-recorded-purpose-read.spec.ts, "opening a recorded Purpose case reads its pinned source through the dashboard exactly once", `expect(projectFileReadsOf(doughnutCaseFeaturePath)).toBe(1)` at line 40, counting through `noteProjectFileReads` in dashboard/test-support/intentCodeBrowsePage.ts.

**Commands:** `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES caffeinate -s -i npm run test:e2e -- e2e/intent/intent-recorded-purpose-read.spec.ts --workers=1`; independent witness: a temporary scratch spec repeating the journey and recording every request for the case feature path (deleted).

**Results:** Baseline exit 0 (1 selected, passed, 1658 ms); witness saw one `/__authenticated-read?source=doughnut&intent=project-file&revision=cdecb3c6…&path=e2e_test/features/cli/case_position.feature`. Fault: maintained run exit 1 at line 40, Expected 1, Received 0, after the source text and target-line assertions passed; witness saw the upstream read without `intent=project-file`. Restored: clean status and diff matching the pre-probe state, same command exit 0 (1 selected, passed, 1516 ms).

**Verdict: Caught.** Claim limited to the single-open path to a recorded Purpose case in Project Intent.

**Next proof action:** None for the routing fault. Read-once on reselection (the per-pin cache in useIntentFileRead.ts and repositoryFileReads.ts) is unprobed; the maintained spec never reselects. An extra upstream read alongside the project-file read would not be caught.

**Cost:** baseline 1658 ms, faulted 2076 ms, restored 1516 ms per attempt; about 4–6 s wall clock per focused command. Human and agent effort unavailable. Invocation-to-report elapsed 136687 ms (measured).

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision 7624ed6e709c076a025fc126297749a0eb91e69b, verdict Caught, no follow-up: the reselection cache path predates this story (dashboard/src/repositoryFileReads.ts, last changed 2026-11-21) and the story promises reading at the pinned revision, which the caught assertion protects; an extra upstream read alongside the project read is not a promise of this story.
